scripts.schema:types: npm run schema:lesson && npm run schema:stream && npm run schema:annotation
scripts.schema:lesson: json2ts -i ../shared/schema/lesson.schema.json -o src/board/lesson.generated.ts --bannerComment '/* Generated from shared/schema/lesson.schema.json. Do not edit. */'
scripts.schema:stream: json2ts --cwd ../shared/schema -i ../shared/schema/lesson-stream.schema.json -o src/lessonStream/stream.generated.ts --bannerComment '/* Generated from shared/schema/lesson-stream.schema.json. Do not edit. */'
scripts.schema:annotation: json2ts -i ../shared/schema/annotation.schema.json -o src/annotations/annotation.generated.ts --bannerComment '/* Generated from shared/schema/annotation.schema.json. Do not edit. */'
scripts.build: npm run schema:types && tsc -b && vite build
